label: [Microangiopathies thrombotiques].
summary: THROMBOTIC MICROANGIOPATHIES. The syndrome of thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA) is defined by the combination of mechanical hemolytic anemia, consumptive thrombocytopenia, and organ failure secondary to microvascular obstruction by microthrombi.
